hints.title: Root to Node Path Traversal
hints.text: Traverse the rooted tree downward while keeping track of the path from the root to the current node.

hints.title: Prefix Distances on Branches
hints.text: Record running prefix distances along the ancestral branch to compute path lengths between any ancestor and descendant in constant time.

hints.title: Tracking Ancestor Depths
hints.text: Maintain the latest depth where each node value appears along the current path. The start of any valid special path cannot precede that depth.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def longestSpecialPath(self, edges: list[list[int]], nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        import sys
        sys.setrecursionlimit(200000)
        n = len(nums)
        adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for u, v, w in edges:
            adj[u].append((v, w))
            adj[v].append((u, w))
        
        pos = {}
        dist = [0]
        path = [0]
        max_len = 0
        min_nodes = 1
        
        def dfs(u, p, top_idx):
            nonlocal max_len, min_nodes
            val = nums[u]
            prev_depth = pos.get(val, -1)
            new_top = max(top_idx, prev_depth + 1)
            
            curr_len = dist[-1] - dist[new_top]
            curr_nodes = len(path) - new_top
            if curr_len > max_len:
                max_len = curr_len
                min_nodes = curr_nodes
            elif curr_len == max_len and curr_len > 0:
                min_nodes = min(min_nodes, curr_nodes)
            
            pos[val] = len(path) - 1
            for v, w in adj[u]:
                if v != p:
                    dist.append(dist[-1] + w)
                    path.append(v)
                    dfs(v, u, new_top)
                    path.pop()
                    dist.pop()
            if prev_depth != -1:
                pos[val] = prev_depth
            else:
                del pos[val]
        
        dfs(0, -1, 0)
        return [max_len, min_nodes]
```

variables: n: number of nodes in the tree
complexity.notes: Traverses tree with DFS while tracking ancestor depths in a hash map with constant time backtracking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking every downward path independently takes quadratic time which exceeds limits for fifty thousand nodes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear auxiliary storage maintains recursion stack, prefix distances, and ancestral depth positions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines tree traversal with two pointer sliding window constraints on tree paths.
